posts.zh:
treg 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。给 Agent 的工具目录：按「要做的事」检索约 2,600 个外部接口（SEO 与 SERP、外链、社交、人物与公司信息补全、广告库、抓取），查看参数与单次调用价格后直接调用，凭据由服务端注入。附带技能，MCP 行在未设置 TREG_TOKEN 前保持禁用。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8cf7759fca9297113bf9.html
posts.en:
treg is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Tool catalog for agents: search ~2,600 external endpoints (SEO and SERP, backlinks, social, people and company enrichment, ad libraries, scraping) by the task you want done, read each one's parameters and per-call price, then call it with the credential injected server-side. Ships the skill plus an MCP row that stays disabled until TREG_TOKEN is set.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8cf7759fca9297113bf9.html
